ruleSet.name: studio-blog
ruleSet.description: Companion blog post endpoints for Studio (issues #66/#68-72): POST /api/blog (Gemini blog writer, async) + blog image uploads (/api/uploads/blog/{prepare,register,*}). Split into its own set; attach alongside the main `studio` set (591dab6e) on the studio + studio-preview aliases. Reuses studio_jobs (46f5eef6) + studio_source (862a1fd2) schemas.

pipelineConfig.name: Blog writer (async enqueue + poll)
pipelineConfig.description: Story 69: live /api/blog, a sibling of the master director. Enqueue a studio_jobs row (kind 'blog') and return { jobId } immediately; the slow multimodal Gemini call + parse run in postSteps and write the row to done/error.

rules.description: Blog writer (story 69; async fire-and-poll, modeled on /api/scenes). ENQUEUE-ONLY response path: prep builds the prompt/system + signed contact-sheet paths, createJob inserts a studio_jobs row (kind 'blog'), respond returns { jobId, status:'pending' }. The multimodal Gemini 3.1 Pro call + parse run in postSteps and write the row to done/error. FE polls GET /api/studio/job.

pipelineConfig.name: Prepare studio blog upload
pipelineConfig.description: Mint a presigned PUT URL so the browser uploads each re-captured blog frame straight to the bucket (image/*) under the blog/ subDir (issue #70).

rules.description: Prepare: mint presigned PUT URL for direct-to-bucket studio blog image (re-captured frame) upload

pipelineConfig.name: Register studio blog upload
pipelineConfig.description: Verify the bucket object and write the upload record (finalize step of the direct-to-bucket blog frame flow). Reuses the studio_source schema; the blog/ subDir distinguishes records (issue #70).

rules.description: Register: finalize a direct-to-bucket studio blog image upload into studio_source

pipelineConfig.name: Serve studio blog images
pipelineConfig.description: Serve files from the blog subDir

rules.description: Serve files from studio blog (Range-aware) so the read-only preview can fetch the inline frames
